mapper.select: SELECT LPAD(SUBSTRING(Symbol,1,8),8,' ') AS symbolPrefix, DESCRIPTION AS description, FUNCTION_GROUP AS functionGroup FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_VARIANT WHERE FAMILY_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{familyId}, '%') AND VARIANT_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{variantId}, '%') ORDER BY CONCAT(LPAD(FUNCTION_GROUP,4,' '), LPAD(FAMILY_ID,3,'0'))
